tom.b: quick update from the Opal-13B int4 onboarding run. ran mixed-batch eval across chat, longform summarize, and a small rerank harness. cost per-token ~47% lower vs fp16 on our infra.
sana: what are the hit slices? any big surprises?
tom.b: single-turn chat + short summaries are fine. biggest hits: (1) chain-of-thought style longform generation (>=1500 tokens) where factuality drops and we see longer hallucination spans; (2) multi-stage reranks where score calibration shifts (nDCG -5). interestingly, completions with heavy numeric tables also degrade.
liam: did you try dynamic sequence-dependent quant switching? like degrade precision if tokens>threshold?
tom.b: yeswe prototyped a dynamic-routing policy: token_count <= 800 -> int4, 801-1600 -> hybrid (attention/proj int8, FF int4), >1600 -> int8. hybrid build recovers ~60% of the gap on longform while keeping ~35% cost savings vs fp16. config we used pasted below.

```
policy = {
  "short": {"precision":"int4"},
  "mid": {"attention":"int8","ffn":"int4"},
  "long": {"precision":"int8"}
}
```

maya: nice. what about quantization method? per-channel vs group-wise? calibration method?
tom.b: did group-wise symmetric (group=32) and per-channel asymmetric for KV. calibration: compared MLQ vs percentile-based. baseline int4 used MLQ symmetric group=128 and that was the worst for longform. group=32 + asymmetric per-channel for KV was best offline. wrote small note: "KV per-channel + group=32 for MLP".
sana: operational recommendation? full rollout or mixed-fleet?
liam: mixed-fleet + dynamic routing seems promising. route via header `X-RW-Seq-Tokens` and `X-RW-Mode` (rerank|longform|chat). product to add flagging. fallback: if model.low_confidence_score > 0.6 on mid build, route remainder of session to int8.
maya: how do we compute low_confidence_score? use perplexity spike + residual norm on KV?
tom.b: prototyped simple: normalized perplexity increase >20% vs baseline OR mean residual-norm(layer 16-22) > threshold -> mark low_conf. We'll export these as `rw_confidence` field for routing decisions.
liam: economics? modeled numbers?
tom.b: modeled three scenarios:
- aggressive: route 80% short->int4, 15% mid->hybrid, 5% long->int8 => org token cost -40%
- conservative: treat any multi-turn >5 turns as long -> results in -22% org cost
- hybrid-dynamic (what we recommend initially): token threshold routing + confidence fallback -> -30% org cost, with expected parity on UX for 98% of sessions.
sana: monitoring and canary plan?
tom.b: propose: canary 4% traffic for 96h. metrics:
- automated checks every 6h: ROUGE-L, nDCG, perplexity delta on sampled slices
- real-time anomaly: support flags + human complaints
- shadow-run: send mid/long requests to int4/hybrid in shadow for 14d, store outputs for diffing
- human-eval: 75 longform + 75 rerank before canary
maya: rollback thresholds?
liam: rollback if longform ROUGE-L drop >6 pts on production sampled set OR rerank nDCG drop >4 AND complaint rate +0.8% absolute.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: `opal13b-int4-dynamic-canary` -> starts 2026-04-10T04:30Z, alloc 4%.
sana: mitigation experiments to run during canary:
- per-channel calibration sweep (percentile 99.5/99.9, MLQ)
- group-size sweep (16/32/64) for MLP layers
- small targeted distillation for longform heads (student model trains on long-sample corpus for 1 epoch)
- mixed-precision middle-layer fallback (auto-upgrade to int8 for layers flagged by residual norm)

maya: I'll wire the rw_confidence hook into routing service and add dashboard panels for residual-norm by layer.
tom.b: product help needed: add `X-RW-Mode` and token_count header so we can implement the token-threshold rule. @liam can you take point with product?
liam: on it. will ping product tomorrow with proposed header schema.
sana: can we also export a compact delta bundle per request (small hash + summary) so GTN can review changes quickly?
tom.b: good idea. we'll include a `rw_delta_summary` with rouge/nDCG/perp diffs for shadowed outputs.
liam: final note: per-customer opt-out for int4 should be available (enterprise customers can request fp16-only). policy doc to update.
maya: agreed. will add opt-out header `X-RW-Precision: fp16` and make it respected by routing.
tom.b: thanks all. i'll draft the recommendation doc + cost table and share for GTN by EOD Monday. :rocket:
